text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф has reclaimed her honor
after the
exhibition race, but she has no
intention of
stopping here. She sets her
sights on the Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But this time, she isn't putting herself
under as
much pressure. She even has
enough free time to
enjoy a trip to a
teahouse with me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
